1 مَخَرَتِ السَّفِينَةُ , (S, A, K,) or مخرت السفينة المَآءَ, (TA,) aor.
مَخَرَ (S, K) and
مَخُرَ , (S, TA,) inf. n. مَخْرٌ and مُخُورٌ, (S, K,) The ship clave the water with its stem, and ran: (AHeyth:) or clave the water with a noise: (A:) or ran, cleaving the water with a noise: (S:) or ran: or faced the wind in her course: (K:) or advanced and retired. (TA.) And مَخَرَ السَّابِحُ The swimmer clave the water with his arms (K, TA.) in swimming. (TA.) The primary signification of مَخْرٌ is the act of cleaving: and it also signifies the making a noise or sound. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
